chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Zurarah, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
If the witness says that he had sat with her in the manner of a man with his wife, the hadd punishment is established against him.

key_terms.أُقِيمَ: it is carried out or enforced
key_terms.الشَّاهِدُ: the witness giving testimony in a legal case
key_terms.جَلَسَ: sat; used here as part of a legal euphemistic description
key_terms.مَجْلِسَ الرَّجُلِ مِنِ امْرَأَتِهِ: the manner of a man with his wife; an expression indicating conjugal sexual intercourse

ai.seo_question: What wording in a witness’s testimony is sufficient to establish the hadd for zina?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the establishment of the hadd in a zina case based on a witness’s testimony using a specific expression. It belongs to the jurisprudential discussions of evidentiary standards and judicial rulings in Islamic law.
